# shipd_audit_settings (Resource)

Manages the requested audit retention for one organization. Use one Terraform address per organization. Use an organization-wide service-account token with audit:read for import and refresh and organization:update for changes. Destroy relinquishes management and leaves the current retention policy in effect.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shipd_audit_settings" "organization" {
  organization_id = "org_123"
  retention_days  = 7
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID. It must match the credential's organization.
- `retention_days` (Number) Requested retention in days, from 7 to 2555, subject to the plan limit and protected minimum. Set to 0 to keep events indefinitely under an unlimited entitlement.

### Read-Only

- `default_retention_days` (Number) Default requested retention before the plan limit and protected minimum are applied.
- `id` (String) The organization ID used to identify this singleton.
- `legal_hold` (Boolean) Whether a legal hold prevents expiry and changes to retention.
- `minimum_retention_days` (Number) Protected organization minimum in days, or 0 when no minimum is configured.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import shipd_audit_settings.organization org_123
```
